params.descricao: Quem derrotar Stalks Death ganha +1 VP
Pode usar Gifts Philodox em adicao aos normais

_metadata.texto_original: Stalks-Death has never lost a combat in his life. Anyone who defeats him may take a 'trophy,' earning them +1 victory points for killing him. He may use Philodox Gifts in addition to his normal ones.
